questions.question_text: Explain how indigenous traditional knowledge in India offers eco-friendly solutions to modern environmental challenges.
questions.correct_answer: Traditional knowledge systems, such as the Khasi living root bridges or Manipuri Loktak lake conservation, demonstrate harmonious bio-engineering. Instead of destroying ecosystems with steel and concrete, indigenous communities work with natural growth cycles. These living structures prevent soil erosion, resist monsoon decay, support biodiversity, and prove that human infrastructure can integrate cleanly into natural ecosystems.
